tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: List the signed-in user's lead lists with the number of leads in each
tools.sql: SELECT li.id, li.name, li.purpose, li.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_lists ll WHERE ll.list_id = li.id) AS lead_count FROM lists li WHERE li.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY li.name COLLATE NOCASE LIMIT 500

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a lead list (a category of leads for one purpose or role)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO lists (id, user_id, name, purpose, created_at) VALUES (:id, :__user_id, :name, :purpose, :__now)

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Rename a lead list or change its purpose
tools.sql: UPDATE lists SET name = :name, purpose = :purpose WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete a lead list. The leads themselves stay in the database
statements: DELETE FROM lead_lists WHERE list_id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM lists WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: Browse the signed-in user's leads, optionally filtered by list, status, or a search term, and sorted. list_ids is a comma-separated string of the lists each lead belongs to. last_message_at is the time of the most recent recorded message (epoch ms), null if none; last_reply_at is the time of the lead's most recent message to the user (direction 'in'), null if they never replied
tools.sql: SELECT l.*, (SELECT group_concat(ll.list_id) FROM lead_lists ll WHERE ll.lead_id = l.id) AS list_ids, (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) AS last_message_at, (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') AS last_reply_at FROM leads l WHERE l.user_id = :__user_id AND (:list_id IS NULL OR l.id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM lead_lists WHERE list_id = :list_id AND user_id = :__user_id)) AND (:status IS NULL OR l.status = :status) AND (:q IS NULL OR l.name LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.company LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.source LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.title LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.email LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR l.phone LIKE '%' || :q || '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN :dir = 'desc' THEN NULL ELSE CASE :sort WHEN 'email' THEN l.email WHEN 'status' THEN (CASE l.status WHEN 'new' THEN 0 WHEN 'contacted' THEN 1 WHEN 'replied' THEN 2 WHEN 'qualified' THEN 3 WHEN 'won' THEN 4 WHEN 'lost' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) WHEN 'last_contact' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) WHEN 'last_reply' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') WHEN 'created' THEN l.created_at ELSE l.name END END COLLATE NOCASE ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN :dir = 'desc' THEN CASE :sort WHEN 'email' THEN l.email WHEN 'status' THEN (CASE l.status WHEN 'new' THEN 0 WHEN 'contacted' THEN 1 WHEN 'replied' THEN 2 WHEN 'qualified' THEN 3 WHEN 'won' THEN 4 WHEN 'lost' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END) WHEN 'last_contact' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id) WHEN 'last_reply' THEN (SELECT MAX(m.occurred_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'in') WHEN 'created' THEN l.created_at ELSE l.name END END COLLATE NOCASE DESC NULLS LAST, l.name COLLATE NOCASE, l.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

q.description: Search name, company, source, title, email, phone

sort.description: Sort by name, email, status (pipeline order), last_contact, last_reply, or created

dir.description: asc or desc. Leads with no value always sort last

tools.name: count_leads
tools.description: Total number of leads in the signed-in user's database
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM leads WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Add a lead (contact) to the database. LINKS ONLY: every social profile field (linkedin, twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube, github) must be the full https:// URL of the profile on that platform, or null when the URL is unknown. Never send a person's name, a handle, or a display label in these fields. If any of them is not a valid profile URL the lead is NOT saved and the result shows "changes": 0 — call check_lead_links with the same values to see which field was rejected.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO leads (id, user_id, name, title, company, source, email, phone, website, location, linkedin, twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube, github, status, notes, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, :name, :title, :company, :source, :email, :phone, :website, :location, :linkedin, :twitter, :instagram, :facebook, :tiktok, :youtube, :github, :status, :notes, :__now, :__now WHERE (:linkedin IS NULL OR (:linkedin NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:linkedin LIKE 'https://%linkedin.com/_%'))) AND (:twitter IS NULL OR (:twitter NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:twitter LIKE 'https://%x.com/_%' OR :twitter LIKE 'https://%twitter.com/_%'))) AND (:instagram IS NULL OR (:instagram NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:instagram LIKE 'https://%instagram.com/_%'))) AND (:facebook IS NULL OR (:facebook NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:facebook LIKE 'https://%facebook.com/_%' OR :facebook LIKE 'https://%fb.com/_%' OR :facebook LIKE 'https://%fb.me/_%'))) AND (:tiktok IS NULL OR (:tiktok NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:tiktok LIKE 'https://%tiktok.com/_%'))) AND (:youtube IS NULL OR (:youtube NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:youtube LIKE 'https://%youtube.com/_%' OR :youtube LIKE 'https://%youtu.be/_%'))) AND (:github IS NULL OR (:github NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:github LIKE 'https://%github.com/_%')))

source.description: Where the lead was found: the Facebook group, community, event or page (e.g. 'Facebook group: Jobs in Melbourne'). Not the lead's employer - that is company

linkedin.description: LinkedIn profile LINK — the full URL starting with https:// on linkedin.com, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL; a non-URL value makes the whole call fail

twitter.description: X / Twitter profile LINK — the full URL starting with https:// on x.com or twitter.com, e.g. https://x.com/janedoe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL; a non-URL value makes the whole call fail

instagram.description: Instagram profile LINK — the full URL starting with https:// on instagram.com, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/janedoe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL; a non-URL value makes the whole call fail

facebook.description: Facebook profile LINK — the full URL starting with https:// on facebook.com or fb.com or fb.me, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/jane.doe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL; a non-URL value makes the whole call fail

tiktok.description: TikTok profile LINK — the full URL starting with https:// on tiktok.com, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/@janedoe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL; a non-URL value makes the whole call fail

youtube.description: YouTube profile LINK — the full URL starting with https:// on youtube.com or youtu.be, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/@janedoe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL; a non-URL value makes the whole call fail

github.description: GitHub profile LINK — the full URL starting with https:// on github.com, e.g. https://github.com/janedoe. NOT the person's name and NOT a handle. Send null if you do not have the URL; a non-URL value makes the whole call fail

status.description: new, contacted, replied, qualified, won, or lost

tools.name: update_lead
tools.description: Update every field of a lead (fields you omit are cleared). LINKS ONLY: every social profile field (linkedin, twitter, instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube, github) must be the full https:// URL of the profile on that platform, or null when the URL is unknown. Never send a person's name, a handle, or a display label in these fields. If any of them is not a valid profile URL the lead is NOT saved and the result shows "changes": 0 — call check_lead_links with the same values to see which field was rejected. "changes": 0 can also mean the id does not exist.
tools.sql: UPDATE leads SET name = :name, title = :title, company = :company, source = :source, email = :email, phone = :phone, website = :website, location = :location, linkedin = :linkedin, twitter = :twitter, instagram = :instagram, facebook = :facebook, tiktok = :tiktok, youtube = :youtube, github = :github, status = :status, notes = :notes, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id AND (:linkedin IS NULL OR (:linkedin NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:linkedin LIKE 'https://%linkedin.com/_%'))) AND (:twitter IS NULL OR (:twitter NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:twitter LIKE 'https://%x.com/_%' OR :twitter LIKE 'https://%twitter.com/_%'))) AND (:instagram IS NULL OR (:instagram NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:instagram LIKE 'https://%instagram.com/_%'))) AND (:facebook IS NULL OR (:facebook NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:facebook LIKE 'https://%facebook.com/_%' OR :facebook LIKE 'https://%fb.com/_%' OR :facebook LIKE 'https://%fb.me/_%'))) AND (:tiktok IS NULL OR (:tiktok NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:tiktok LIKE 'https://%tiktok.com/_%'))) AND (:youtube IS NULL OR (:youtube NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:youtube LIKE 'https://%youtube.com/_%' OR :youtube LIKE 'https://%youtu.be/_%'))) AND (:github IS NULL OR (:github NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:github LIKE 'https://%github.com/_%')))

tools.name: check_lead_links
tools.description: Validate social profile links before or after create_lead / update_lead. Returns one row with a verdict per field: 'ok', or 'REJECTED' with the reason. Writes nothing.
tools.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (:linkedin IS NULL OR (:linkedin NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:linkedin LIKE 'https://%linkedin.com/_%'))) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'REJECTED - must be the full https URL of the profile on linkedin.com, for example https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe - not a name or a handle. Send null when the URL is unknown' END AS linkedin, CASE WHEN (:twitter IS NULL OR (:twitter NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:twitter LIKE 'https://%x.com/_%' OR :twitter LIKE 'https://%twitter.com/_%'))) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'REJECTED - must be the full https URL of the profile on x.com or twitter.com, for example https://x.com/janedoe - not a name or a handle. Send null when the URL is unknown' END AS twitter, CASE WHEN (:instagram IS NULL OR (:instagram NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:instagram LIKE 'https://%instagram.com/_%'))) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'REJECTED - must be the full https URL of the profile on instagram.com, for example https://www.instagram.com/janedoe - not a name or a handle. Send null when the URL is unknown' END AS instagram, CASE WHEN (:facebook IS NULL OR (:facebook NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:facebook LIKE 'https://%facebook.com/_%' OR :facebook LIKE 'https://%fb.com/_%' OR :facebook LIKE 'https://%fb.me/_%'))) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'REJECTED - must be the full https URL of the profile on facebook.com or fb.com or fb.me, for example https://www.facebook.com/jane.doe - not a name or a handle. Send null when the URL is unknown' END AS facebook, CASE WHEN (:tiktok IS NULL OR (:tiktok NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:tiktok LIKE 'https://%tiktok.com/_%'))) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'REJECTED - must be the full https URL of the profile on tiktok.com, for example https://www.tiktok.com/@janedoe - not a name or a handle. Send null when the URL is unknown' END AS tiktok, CASE WHEN (:youtube IS NULL OR (:youtube NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:youtube LIKE 'https://%youtube.com/_%' OR :youtube LIKE 'https://%youtu.be/_%'))) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'REJECTED - must be the full https URL of the profile on youtube.com or youtu.be, for example https://www.youtube.com/@janedoe - not a name or a handle. Send null when the URL is unknown' END AS youtube, CASE WHEN (:github IS NULL OR (:github NOT LIKE '% %' AND (:github LIKE 'https://%github.com/_%'))) THEN 'ok' ELSE 'REJECTED - must be the full https URL of the profile on github.com, for example https://github.com/janedoe - not a name or a handle. Send null when the URL is unknown' END AS github

tools.name: delete_lead
tools.description: Delete a lead, its recorded conversation, and its list memberships
statements: DELETE FROM messages WHERE lead_id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM lead_lists WHERE lead_id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id
DELETE FROM leads WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: add_lead_to_list
tools.description: Put a lead in a list. A lead can be in many lists
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO lead_lists (lead_id, list_id, user_id, created_at) SELECT l.id, li.id, :__user_id, :__now FROM leads l, lists li WHERE l.id = :lead_id AND li.id = :list_id AND l.user_id = :__user_id AND li.user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: remove_lead_from_list
tools.description: Take a lead out of a list. The lead stays in the database
tools.sql: DELETE FROM lead_lists WHERE lead_id = :lead_id AND list_id = :list_id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read the recorded conversation with a lead, oldest first. Every message has its exact time (occurred_at, epoch ms), platform, direction ('in' from the lead, 'out' to the lead) and full body. Page with offset to read everything
tools.sql: SELECT id, lead_id, platform, direction, body, occurred_at, created_at FROM messages WHERE lead_id = :lead_id AND user_id = :__user_id AND (:platform IS NULL OR platform = :platform) ORDER BY occurred_at, created_at LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: add_message
tools.description: Record one message of a conversation with a lead, with the exact time it happened and the platform it happened on
tools.sql: INSERT INTO messages (id, user_id, lead_id, platform, direction, body, occurred_at, created_at) SELECT :id, :__user_id, l.id, :platform, :direction, :body, :occurred_at, :__now FROM leads l WHERE l.id = :lead_id AND l.user_id = :__user_id

platform.description: Where it happened, e.g. LinkedIn, Email, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Phone call, In person, Other

direction.description: 'out' if the signed-in user sent it, 'in' if the lead sent it

occurred_at.description: Exact time the message was sent, as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC)

tools.name: update_message
tools.sql: UPDATE messages SET platform = :platform, direction = :direction, body = :body, occurred_at = :occurred_at WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id

platform.description: Where it happened, e.g. LinkedIn, Email, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Phone call, In person, Other

direction.description: 'out' if the signed-in user sent it, 'in' if the lead sent it

occurred_at.description: Exact time the message was sent, as Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC)

tools.name: delete_message
tools.sql: DELETE FROM messages WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :__user_id
